items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: before I joined the band, he had had such luminaries as Nick Kaspian was with him.

ctx.x: And Nick used to play the piano -- they always had the house piano player that just played solo piano, and then he'd have two pianos, you know? So Bobby Hackett asked me to go in there, when I went in with Bobby Hackett, he had a -- Billy Maxted was on piano, a very good piano player. But he had just got out -- he was, and people

don't know this, that he was a pilot, a fighter pilot during the war, and he was trying to get himself straightened out, too. He needed a job. So we all went in together. He used to write arrangements for Bob Crosby's great orchestra.
